# Copilot Instructions

This is a TypeScript library generated by [cookiecutter-project-kit](https://github.com/samuelduchesne/cookiecutter-project-kit). It uses **pnpm** for dependencies, **Biome** for linting and formatting, **TypeScript** (strict) and **Vitest**.

## Commands

```bash
pnpm install      # install dependencies
pnpm format       # lint and format with Biome (writes fixes)
pnpm typecheck    # tsc
pnpm test         # vitest
pnpm build        # emit dist/
make check && make test   # full quality gate
```
{% if cookiecutter.agent_profile == "full" %}
## Conventions

- ES modules; relative imports end in `.js`
- No `any`; type every exported function; `import type` for type-only imports
- TSDoc comments on every export
- Throw specific errors (`TypeError`, `RangeError`) with clear messages

## Testing

- Tests live in `tests/*.test.ts` and import from `../src/*.js`
- Cover the error paths as well as the happy path

```ts
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { greet } from "../src/index.js";

it("rejects an empty name", () => {
  expect(() => greet(" ")).toThrow(RangeError);
});
```

- Create the category heading if it is missing; skip internal-only changes (refactors, tests, CI)
